resources.string: Your sleep and energy patterns change over time based on age and hormones.
Your sleep needs change with age. Knowing age help us offer better guidance.
Sleep need is higher for teens and adolescents than adults.
Our biological clocks are set to the latest they will ever be around the age of 20.
After age 20, our biological clocks adjust our sleep and wake times earlier.
Due to the demands of life, sleep duration starts to decrease around age 30.
People tend to get the least sleep around age 40.
People in their 50s sleep less and start to have trouble failing and staying asleep.
Difficulty falling and staying asleep is the most common sleep problem in adults 60+.
